Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good

- Every converted line keeps its text. Only the print call changes to a `tracing` event. The refusals still drop the bad value first. No silent change of behaviour.
- `log_init` in each standalone bin is fallible: `try_from_env` and `try_init` cannot panic. This obeys the Prime Directive.
- The `diag` seam law test now proves the rule with a captured subscriber: `diag_lines_are_tracing_events_at_their_level` and `a_refused_axis_or_angle_is_a_warning_under_the_cl_target`. A filter below the level stays quiet.
- The tightened allow-list is honest. I checked every file it drops: no direct print remains outside the seam and test-only code. `crates/ui/src/main.rs` calls `camcraft_app::logging::init()` before the shell runs, so no UI event loses its subscriber.
- No new external dependency. `tracing` and `tracing-subscriber` are already workspace entries. The lock diff adds only those edges. `docs/decisions/163-tracing-libs.md` records the choice and the dropped shared-helper option.
- The commit subject is conventional. The body has the `Changelog:` line, ends `Fixes #163` and says `Process change: no`. No process file is touched.

## Results, merged with main

The head already merges current main (`3e47b898b` is an ancestor of `f69a955e5`). The trial merge is a no-op. Built locally in a review worktree on Windows. The delta since the earlier pass `33cf46fbe` is only merges of main.

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-cl` (lib + bins + `refusal_log`) | pass: 5 + 1 + 0, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-tools` | pass: 184 + 3 + 5 + 5, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-sim` | pass, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-geometry` | pass: 46 + 2 + 16 + 15, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-motion` | 1 failure: `adaptive_entry_pieces::a_narrow_second_piece_names_its_ramp_stand_in_at_each_level` - the known red of issue #2426 on main. The test asserts `t.notes` strings. This PR changes none. All other motion binaries pass (421-run: 415 passed, 6 ignored). |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` | pass: 1055, 0 failed, 6 ignored - includes both new seam tests |
| `cargo clippy` on the six touched crates, `--all-targets -D warnings` | clean, exit 0 |

The `MIN_LABEL_PX` clippy blocker named in the body is gone from current main (#2104 closed), so it did not appear here.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell_window.rs:61` logs "mcp: listening on ..." with `diag_warn!`. It went to stderr before, so nothing regresses. An `info` line may suit a success note better. Your call.
2. `camcraft: ` prefix dropped from the catalog warning (`crates/tools/src/catalog_asset.rs:222`): the event target now names the crate. Acceptable.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is the independent review of this head. An earlier agent of ours stopped mid-review. This review completes it.

What looks good:
- The PR moves library and UI diagnostics to `tracing` events. It keeps the refusal conditions, the fallback values and the calculations.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!()` was added. `log_init` is fallible. Each binary installs the subscriber before it calls the libraries.
- The refusal texts stay the same for the user.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/163-tracing-libs.md` records the new dependency edges.
- The body has the `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #163`. No process file changed. No snapshot PNG changed.

Results (locally, in the review worktree, head merged with main `3e47b898b`):
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`): passed. 1055 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The `camcraft-tools` and `camcraft-sim` suites passed (first pass of this review, same head).
- The geometry and motion suites: one failure, `adaptive_entry_pieces::a_narrow_second_piece_names_its_ramp_stand_in_at_each_level`. This is the known red of main (issue #2426, from merged #2383). It came in through the merge commit. It is inherited main red (#2426), not attributable to this PR.

Remerge-diff check of the hand-resolved merge `f69a955e5`:
- `Cargo.lock` and `crates/tools/Cargo.toml`: both sides kept. The branch keeps `tracing` and `tracing-subscriber`; main's `camcraft-geometry` edge in `crates/tools` stays.
- `crates/geometry/Cargo.toml`: the resolution removed only a duplicated `tracing` line. Nothing else was dropped.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell_window/frame.rs`: main's new frame-rate line now uses `diag_warn!`. The condition and the message text stay the same.
- No hand resolution dropped logic.

Questions / notes (not blocking):
- This review ran the targeted suites, not the full batch gate. The post-merge gate on main will cover the rest.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
